integrity: All public claims are accompanied by analytic proof steps and a replayable standard-library checker; provisional historical priority, no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive intrinsic growth rate, two equally long constant-capacity stages, no harvest or stochasticity; result is a mathematical comparison of cumulative and terminal abundance, not a management prescription. General duration inequalities and multiseason orders are unproved.
title: Universal duration boundary for cumulative population under two switched logistic carrying capacities
